clips.title: The story
paras: At Dun Morogh's southern gate, The Adventurer carries supplies toward Kharanos. Mountaineer Thalos asks travelers to bring a bundle to Eric Brighthammer, a newcomer camped just outside the village.

Ironforge Mountaineer Thalos watches the southern gate, where the trail leaves Coldridge Valley for the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. Guarding the high passes and tunnels keeps the Mountaineers busy, and Thalos watches for dangers as well as travelers on the road. When he hears that a lone adventurer has arrived near Kharanos, he asks trusted passersby to carry supplies onward. The bundle is meant to support newcomers venturing into the frozen crags.

The road from the southern pass winds down to Kharanos, a center of dwarven craft and travel in central Dun Morogh. Eric Brighthammer has recently made camp just outside the village. Carrying the Mountaineers' bundle of provisions to him links the ridge sentries with those walking the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.
My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, priest.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
